wonderful.definition: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.

wondering.definition: Form of wonder (gerund participle present): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wonders.definition: Form of wonder (plural): A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wont.definition: One's habitual way of doing things; custom, habit, practice.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

wool.definition: The hair of the sheep, llama and some other ruminants.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

worked.definition: Form of work (participle past): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workers.definition: Form of worker (plural): One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worlds.definition: Form of world (plural): The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worshipping.definition: Form of worship (UK gerund participle present): To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

worsted.definition: Yarn made from long strands of wool.

worthless.definition: Having no worth or use; without value.

worts.definition: Form of wort (plural): Now chiefly as the second element in the names of plants: a plant used for food or medicine.

wot.definition: Form of wit (first-person indicative present singular): To know, be aware of (constructed with of when used intransitively).

wottest.definition: Form of wit (archaic indicative present second-person singular): To know, be aware of (constructed with of when used intransitively).

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wouldst.definition: Form of will (archaic indicative past second-person singular): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wound.definition: Form of wind (participle past): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

wounds.definition: Form of wound (plural): An injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body.

woven.definition: Form of weave (participle past): To form something by passing lengths or strands of material over and under one another.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: Form of youth (plural): The quality or state of being young.
